'''Que-Mars Redath-Gom''' was a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was raised independently from members of his [[species]], causing him to not follow the [[Quay totem]], which decided a Weequay's fate. Through not following the totem, Redath-Gom was able to become a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. He was killed during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], where the Weequay was [[Jedi assault team/Legends|one of many Jedi]] who rescued the Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. 

==Biography==
Que-Mars Redath-Gom was a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Jedi/Legends|member]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="NEGAS" /> who grew up within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]<ref name="Galactic Files">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2|cardname=Que-Mars Redath-Gom (Jedi Knight)|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/93283/cid/6569457/2013-Topps-Star-Wars:-Galactic-Files-Series-2-431-Que-Mars-Redath-Gom|archivedate=20231103100734}}</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Temple">{{DB|location|jeditemple|Jedi Temple}}</ref> As he was raised independently from other members of the Weequay [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="NEGAS" /> Redath-Gom did not follow the rules of the [[Quay totem]], which was used to decide a Weequay's fate. Without it, however, he was able to become a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="Galactic Files" />

[[File:GeonosisJediDieDeflectingShots.jpg|thumb|300px|right|Que-Mars Redath-Gom was one of many Jedi who died during the First Battle of Geonosis.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Redath-Gom joined<ref name="Galactic Files" /> the [[Jedi assault team/Legends|group of Jedi]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to rescue the Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] from their scheduled execution by [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist leaders]]<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> in the [[Petranaki arena|Petranaki arena]]<ref name="NEGAS" /> on the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="Galactic Files" /> The Jedi Knight fought gallantly during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]],<ref name="Galactic Files" /> but was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Both the memory of Redath-Gom and the fellow Weequay Jedi [[Kossex]] were unaccepted in the Weequay populace due to their unreliance of the Quay totem.<ref name="NEGAS" />

==Personality and traits==
Redath-Gom served the Jedi Order faithfully.<ref name="Galactic Files" /> He had [[Color/Legends|black]] eyes, braided brown hair, and brown skin.<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Skills and abilities==
Redath-Gom was above average in his intelligence, usage of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], strength, and speed. The Weequay had slightly-above average diplomacy skills and had a powerful fighting ability. During the First Battle of Geonosis, Redath-Gom fought gallantly.<ref name="Galactic Files" />

==Equipment==
The Jedi Knight wielded a green-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. During the First Battle of Geonosis, Redath-Gom wore a white [[Clothing/Legends|undertunic]], a tan overtunic, a brown [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]], tan pants, and brown boots. Over the [[Jedi apparel/Legends|ensemble]], he wore a hooded brown cloak.<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Behind the scenes==
Que-Mars Redath-Gom first appeared in the<ref name="AotC" /> [[2002]]<ref name="Year2">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="AotC" /> The character was first identified in the ''[[Star Wars Saga Daily Calendar 2003]]'',<ref name="Calendar">''[[Star Wars Saga Daily Calendar 2003]]''</ref> released on [[August 14|August 1]], 2002.<ref name="Amazon-Calender">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Classic-Daily-Calendar/dp/0768357705|text=Star Wars Classic Daily Calendar (2003)}}</ref>
